future_execution.existing_leader: `php artisan migrate` would run only post-baseline migrations not yet recorded (currently 2026_10_01_000001_create_agent_photos_table, intentionally NOT run in Phase 0.5).
future_execution.fresh_environment: `php artisan migrate` on an empty MySQL database runs the canonical baseline, then every post-baseline migration.
future_execution.other_existing_environments: Must first equal the fingerprint (`php artisan lft:baseline:verify`), then `LFT_ALLOW_BASELINE_ADOPTION=1 php artisan lft:baseline:adopt`. Running `migrate` on a populated, unadopted database is refused by the baseline guard.
future_execution.rollback: The baseline down() throws: rollback/reset/refresh past the baseline are refused by design (restore from backup instead).
